settings.headline: The legal entity behind Senseless.
settings.body:
Senseless is a brand of Matrix Health Group Ltd, a UK company in the personal-care and aesthetics sector.

  • Company name: Matrix Health Group Ltd
  • Company number: 17099304
  • Registered address: 128 City Road, London, EC1V 2NX
  • VAT number: to be confirmed before launch
  • Phone: 0333 049 5549

For consumer enquiries, please use the form above or the appropriate channel above. The registered company address isn't a consumer support address.

settings.heading: Response times
settings.body:
Consumer enquiries: 2 working days, typically faster.

Trade enquiries: 2 working days for initial response.

Press enquiries: 1 working day for time-sensitive requests.

Legal / GDPR: As required by applicable law — UK GDPR data subject requests acknowledged within 1 calendar month per regulation.

The team works UK office hours (Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00 GMT/BST). Weekend enquiries are picked up the next working day.
